name: A Fake Artist Goes to New York

rounds.endCondition: First player to reach 5 points wins

categories.label: Points earned (all rounds)
categories.hint: Fake Artist wins: Fake Artist and Question Master +2 each. Real artists win: each artist +1. First to 5 wins.

tiebreakers.description: Not specified in sources; if several players reach 5 in the same round, play on or share the win.

roles.label: Question Master
roles.winCondition: Scores 2 if the Fake Artist wins; does not draw

roles.label: Fake Artist
roles.winCondition: Not identified by most votes, or identified but names the title correctly

roles.label: Artist
roles.winCondition: Fake Artist is pointed at most and fails to name the title

endCondition.description: Game ends when a player has 5 points; Question Master role rotates left each round

notes: family: hidden-role-social. Official Oink rulebook PDF could not be downloaded (BGG login wall); point values taken from Wikipedia and UltraBoardGames and not verified against the rulebook. Enter each player's running point total.
